summary_1line: Indrajit performs rituals, becomes invisible using divine power, and devastates the monkey army with a rain of arrows, wounding many leaders including Rama and Lakshmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indrajit performs a fiery sacrificial ritual before battle, flames swirling as he seizes a goat and invokes the gods beside his war chariot.
Invisible in the sky, Indrajit rains blazing arrows down on the monkey army as warriors fall amid shattered trees and rocks.
The monkey heroes—Hanuman, Sugriva, Angada, and others—stand bloodied under a storm of arrows while the unseen Indrajit attacks from the heavens.
